title: Marketing Co-Ordinator
description:
Marketing Coordinator
Location: Braintree
Department: Marketing
Salary: 28-30 K
Employment Type: Full-Time

The Role
As Marketing Coordinator, you will be responsible for supporting and delivering a wide range of marketing activities across digital, print, social media, product launches, exhibitions, customer communications and internal projects.

This is an excellent opportunity for an ambitious individual who enjoys a varied role and has a passion for marketing, content creation and digital technologies. The successful candidate will be highly organised, commercially aware and comfortable working across multiple projects simultaneously.

Experience of a technical nature would be advantageous, whether gained through previous employment or education.

Key Responsibilities

Marketing & Communications

Social Media & Digital Marketing

AI & Marketing Technology

Product & Technical Marketing Support

Events & Exhibitions

Internal Collaboration

Candidate Profile

Essential Skills & Experience
- Previous experience in a Marketing Coordinator, Marketing Assistant or similar marketing role.
- Strong understanding of social media platforms and content creation.
- Experience using marketing software and digital communication tools.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
- Strong organisational and project management skills.
- Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities simultaneously.
- Proficient in Microsoft Office, particularly PowerPoint, Excel and Teams.
- Strong attention to detail and commitment to high-quality work.
- Commercial awareness and customer-focused mindset.
- Positive, proactive and team-oriented approach.

Desired Skills & Experience
- Experience working within manufacturing, engineering, technical products or ideally the electrical industry.
- Experience with Adobe Creative Suite, Canva or similar design tools.
- Experience managing website content using CMS platforms.
- Knowledge of SEO, Google Analytics and digital marketing metrics.
- Experience creating and editing video content.
- Working knowledge of CRM systems.
- Experience using AI tools such as Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT, Canva AI, Adobe Firefly or similar platforms.
- Basic understanding of automation tools and workflows.

Technical Knowledge
The ideal candidate will possess some technical understanding gained from either:

Employment within the electrical, engineering or manufacturing sectors.

Technical, engineering or electrical qualifications.

Apprenticeship experience.

STEM-related education.

Experience producing technical documentation or product communications.

Candidates are not expected to be technical experts but should be comfortable understanding and communicating technical product information.

Personal Attributes
We are looking for someone who is:

Highly organised and self-motivated.

Creative and commercially minded.

Curious about new technologies and AI.

Professional and confident when communicating with customers and colleagues.

Eager to learn and develop new skills.

Solutions-focused with a positive attitude.

Comfortable working independently and as part of a team.

Adaptable within a fast-paced business environment.

Qualifications
Essential

GCSE English and Maths (or equivalent).

Marketing qualification, degree or relevant industry experience.

Desirable

Degree in Marketing, Business, Communications or related discipline.

CIM qualification or working towards CIM accreditation.

Technical, engineering or electrical qualification.

Digital marketing certification.

title: Paid Media Manager
description:
Paid Media Manager

Location: Essex / Hybrid

Salary: Up to £45,000

Employment: Permanent, full-time

Working pattern: Hybrid, 2 days per week in the office

The Opportunity

We're working with an established digital agency in Essex looking to hire an experienced Paid Media Manager.

This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys the combination of hands-on paid media, strategy and client ownership.

You'll manage a portfolio of accounts across paid search and paid social, taking responsibility for performance and helping clients understand where their next opportunities for growth are.

There's a strong retail and e-commerce element, so experience with Google Shopping, Performance Max and commercially focused paid media campaigns would be particularly valuable.

You'll have support from a wider digital team, while retaining ownership of the strategy, client relationship and quality of work delivered across your accounts.

What You'll Be Doing
- Owning paid media strategy across a portfolio of client accounts.
- Managing campaigns across Google Ads and Meta Ads.
- Working across paid search, paid social, Shopping and Performance Max.
- Analysing campaign performance and identifying opportunities to improve ROAS, revenue and other commercial KPIs.
- Leading regular client calls and communicating performance in a clear, commercially focused way.
- Turning data into practical recommendations and next steps.
- Briefing campaign activity and working with other specialists to get work delivered.
- Reviewing and quality-checking campaigns, reports and recommendations.
- Keeping clients proactively updated on performance and activity.
- Staying close to developments across Google, Meta and the wider paid media landscape.
- Using AI and automation where they can improve analysis, reporting or campaign workflows.

What We're Looking For

You'll already have solid experience managing paid media campaigns and be comfortable taking ownership of both performance and client relationships.

Ideally, you'll bring:
- Strong hands-on Google Ads experience.
- Good working knowledge of Meta Ads.
- Experience managing multiple accounts or campaigns simultaneously.
- Confidence working directly with clients or senior stakeholders.
- Experience with Google Shopping and Performance Max.
- An understanding of retail/e-commerce performance marketing.
- Strong analytical skills and commercial awareness.
- Excellent attention to detail.
- Confidence using platforms such as GA4 and Looker Studio.
- The ability to turn campaign data into clear recommendations rather than simply reporting the numbers.

Agency experience would be useful, although we're equally interested in people from strong in-house performance marketing backgrounds who are comfortable managing multiple priorities.

The Person

You'll suit this role if you're someone who likes taking ownership rather than waiting to be told what to do.

You'll be comfortable getting hands-on in an ad account, but equally happy presenting performance to a client, spotting opportunities and deciding what should happen next.

You don't need to be a technical tracking specialist, but you should understand the wider performance marketing picture and be curious about new platforms, automation and AI.

Package

Salary: Up to £40,000 depending on experience

The business offers a strong benefits package alongside hybrid working, with 2 days per week in the Essex office.

This is a particularly good fit for a Paid Media Manager looking for a role that combines e-commerce, performance strategy, hands-on campaign management and genuine account ownership.

title: Senior Social Media Executive
description:
Senior Social Media Executive - Fashion Brand

Essex Area Salary - DOE

We are partnered with a fast-growing UK fashion retailer known for its trend-led, affordable collections and strong digital presence. With a loyal customer base, frequent new launches and continued investment in ecommerce and customer experience, the business has established itself as a leading name in accessible fashion.

The Role:

This is a unique opportunity for a Social Media Manager to take ownership of the entire social media function for an exciting and growing fashion brand. You will be responsible for developing and delivering a multi-platform social media strategy, building a consistent and premium brand identity while driving meaningful engagement, brand awareness and commercial growth.

Key Responsibilities:
- Develop and implement the overall social media strategy, establishing clear objectives and growth plans across all platforms.
- Build and lead the social media function, managing and mentoring Content Creators and supporting their development.
- Own the brand's presence across Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn and YouTube, creating tailored strategies for each platform.
- Develop a premium, aspirational social identity that appeals to a more mature fashion audience.
- Lead the planning, creation and delivery of engaging and commercially effective social content.
- Create, film, edit and publish high-quality video and photographic content across organic social and paid advertising.
- Lead creative direction for campaigns, product launches, seasonal collections and key brand moments.
- Plan and manage content shoots, including booking models, styling looks and coordinating production schedules.
- Work closely with the in-house photographer and wider Marketing team to deliver high-quality creative.
- Own the social media content calendar, ensuring campaigns, launches, Stories and promotional activity are planned and delivered effectively.
- Maintain a consistent brand identity, tone of voice and visual direction across all social channels.
- Analyse social media performance and use data and insights to continually improve content, engagement, reach and conversion.
- Identify new opportunities to grow the brand through social-first campaigns, trends, creators and innovative content formats.
- Stay ahead of developments across social platforms, fashion trends, consumer behaviour and algorithms.
- Confidently appear on camera when required and direct talent during content shoots.
- Work collaboratively with the wider Marketing and Brand teams to ensure social activity supports wider commercial and brand objectives.

About You:
- 2+ years' experience in social media management, ideally within a fashion, beauty, lifestyle or consumer brand.
- Proven experience developing and executing multi-platform social media strategies.
- Previous experience managing, mentoring or leading Content Creators or a social media team.
- A strong understanding of Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn and YouTube, including platform-specific best practice and emerging trends.
- Excellent video creation, editing and creative storytelling skills, with a strong portfolio of work.
- A highly creative eye with a strong understanding of premium fashion and lifestyle content.

Why Apply?
- Opportunity to build and shape the social strategy from the ground up.
- Lead and mentor a growing team of Content Creators.
- Work for an established and growing fashion and footwear brand with exciting plans for the future.
- Take ownership across Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn and YouTube.
- Combine strategy, leadership and hands-on content creation in one role.
- Have real creative influence over the brand's premium and aspirational social identity.

title: SEO Executive
description:
We've been retained by an established digital marketing agency in Essex to help them recruit a SEO Executive to join its close-knit team. Working with both B2 B and B2 C clients, the agency delivers SEO, ecommerce and content campaigns across sectors including healthcare, automotive, logistics, education, financial services, property and technology.

The Company - SEO Executive

This is a friendly, collaborative agency with a strong track record and a varied client base. The team works closely together, sharing ideas and focusing on activity that delivers meaningful, sustainable results. They also take a refreshingly grown-up approach to working life. The role offers two days a week from home alongside flexibility around working hours when needed. People are trusted to manage their schedules and get their work done without unnecessary formality.

The Role - SEO Executive

This is a varied SEO role covering content, optimisation, reporting and technical work. You'll create and improve content for clients, help develop keyword strategies and use performance data to understand what is working and where improvements can be made.

There is also a technical side to the position. You'll carry out audits, identify issues that could be affecting organic performance and work with developers to put fixes in place.

The agency is already considering how search is changing as a result of AI. You'll therefore have the opportunity to build your knowledge of AI search optimisation alongside more traditional SEO techniques.

Key Responsibilities - SEO Executive
- Writing and optimising blog posts, landing pages, press releases, media pitches, email campaigns and advertising copy
- Making sure content reflects search intent and supports wider conversion objectives
- Refreshing existing content to improve rankings and performance
- Editing content for grammar, style and consistency
- Uploading content through WordPress, Shopify and other content management systems
- Using Semrush, GA4, Screaming Frog and Google Search Console to inform SEO activity
- Monitoring conversions, clicks and user journeys to understand content performance
- Supporting keyword research and targeting strategies
- Running technical audits to identify crawl errors, broken links and redirect chains
- Working with developers on site architecture, structured data and technical fixes
- Helping clients build topical authority across traditional and AI-led search
- Supporting the agency's own marketing activity when required

About You - SEO Executive

You'll already have some practical SEO experience, either within an agency or an in-house marketing team. You should understand the principles of keyword research and content optimisation alongside the technical basics that can affect how a website performs in search.

You'll also be a capable writer with a good eye for detail and the confidence to edit and improve existing content. Experience with tools such as Semrush, GA4, Screaming Frog and Google Search Console would be useful as would experience using WordPress or Shopify.

You don't need to know everything about AI search already, but you should be interested in how search is developing and keen to learn more.

Above all, you'll be someone who takes responsibility for their work, enjoys being part of a small team and appreciates being trusted to manage their time properly.

The package includes performance-related bonuses, private health insurance with dental cover, paid time off over Christmas in addition to the standard holiday allowance and funded opportunities to attend industry events and develop new skills.

title: UFHS - CRM and Marketing Manager
description:
We are actively seeking a highly motivated, dynamic, and results-driven CRM and Marketing Manager to become an integral part of our expanding team.

The Role:

You'll be in charge of developing and implementing our entire CRM and marketing game plan. This role focuses on warmly welcoming new customers, making sure our current customers feel loved, and building lasting loyalty every step of the way.

Key Responsibilities
- Develop and execute data-driven CRM strategies to enhance the customer lifecycle and increase sales/profits.
- Manage and maintain our CRM platform and work with our Sales and Digital teams to drive performance.
- Own our customer-facing Marketing campaigns to support our promotional activity and new product launches.
- Work with our Finance team to improve our customer segmentation to deliver personalised and targeted Marketing and CRM activity.
- Track, analyse, and report on KPIs related to our Marketing and CRM initiatives, to continually drive improvement in these areas.
- Train and support our colleagues to use our CRM platform effectively.

You:

You'll live and breathe our customer-first ethos, with a proactive and forward-thinking approach to learning and expanding your knowledge. You'll be driven to make a real success of your career, actively seeking to learn and understand new challenges and products. You'll be a real team player, working within a small technical team, taking pride in all that you do and the value you add to our customers and business

Us:

The Underfloor Heating Store is a market-leading online retailer of electric and water underfloor heating systems and associated products direct to consumers. Our huge range of underfloor heating products means there's something for every project and every budget. As part of the Highbourne Group which proudly consists of City Plumbing, PTS, DHS, NSS, The Underfloor Heating Store, Plumbnation and Plumbworld, we're proud of our reputation for selling quality products to both trade and retail customers and we're super excited about our future! We put our colleagues at the heart of all we do, giving them all the tools they need to be successful, happy and feel rewarded in their career with us.

Benefits Package and Cultural Envionment:
- Bonus
- Discounts, savings and cash back at numerous retailers
- Life assurance
- Extended family policy including maternity, paternity, additional annual leave and more
- Mental Health First Aiders and Employee Assistance Programme, we look out for each other
- Complete induction and a company that lets you grow and encourages development
- Financial education and loans
- Flexible working options
- A business striving to create an environment of inclusion so everyone can be their true self
- And more!

We're passionate about creating an inclusive workplace that celebrates and values diversity. Bring your whole self to work regardless of age, disability, gender identity or reassignment, marital or civil partner status, pregnancy or maternity, race, colour, nationality, ethnic or national origin, religion or belief, sex or sexual orientation. We don't want you to 'fit' our culture, we want you to enrich it.

We are committed to best practices in recruitment and undertake Basic Criminal Record Disclosures for candidates that are offered employment within our branches that undertake deliveries for British Gas. This check will only be undertaken after the acceptance of an offer of employment.
